text:
The deposition is inadmissible as hearsay not within any recognized exception, so the company’s objection should be sustained. The engineer is unavailable and was deposed, but the former-testimony exception fails because the company lacked a similar motive in the wrongful-termination case to develop the structural-defect testimony. The statement is neither a party-opponent admission nor a statement against the engineer’s interest.

CONFIDENCE: 86
